subject: Gas-Powered Leaf Blower Ban
overview: The committee heard a guest presentation on leaf blower regulations, voted to recommend a ban on gas-powered leaf blowers to the mayor and city council, and discussed preparations for the upcoming Circle the Square event.

items.title: Minutes and Quorum Policy
items.summary: The committee approved the April 4, 2022 minutes and adopted a policy establishing a quorum as seven members for a committee of 14.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Announcements
items.summary: Director Hunt reported on the formation of a Solid Waste Task Force, office hiring, the final Climate Action Plan, and planning for an in-person summer meeting and the Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: Circle the Square Planning
items.summary: Members discussed outreach strategies and materials for their table at the June 18 Circle the Square event, focusing on solar options, heat pumps, urban tree canopy benefits, and transportation.

items.title: Gas-Powered Leaf Blower Ban Presentation and Resolution
items.summary: Following a presentation by Dan Koretz on Lexington's phased restriction on gas-powered leaf blowers, the committee voted unanimously to endorse a ban or phase-out and urge the mayor to support an ordinance and prohibit them on municipal properties.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Members received updates on Arbor Day events, state reforestation bill S.504, a local tree preservation ordinance, and Vision Zero transportation initiatives.
